messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Javier Morales <javier.morales@pritech.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pritech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Plan kickoff & exec handshake — PriTech evaluation timeline

Hi Javier and Elena,

Thanks again for the time on Friday — we left excited about PriTech's goals for Q3 and how Redwood can help reduce inference cost and stabilize latency across your multi-cloud footprint. To get the evaluation moving with clear ownership, I put together a short kickoff plan and a proposed exec handshake. Draft attached (PriTech_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx).

High-level asks and outcomes for the next 8 weeks:
- Confirm exec sponsorship (VP/CTO alignment) so we can unblock procurement and security reviews.
- Agree on success criteria: target p50 latency, cost-per-1k tokens, and one production end-to-end flow for the pilot.
- Schedule two working sessions: 1) technical eval + SSO/security sync, 2) procurement/pricing and contract timeline.

Proposed exec contacts (please correct if wrong):
- PriTech: Javier Morales (CTO) – technical sponsor
- PriTech: Elena Ruiz (VP, Product) – business sponsor
- Redwood exec sponsor: Hannah Schmitt (Head of Customer Success) – escalation path for timeline or scope changes

Action items for this thread:
1) Javier/Elena: confirm the two exec sponsors above and any additions we should include (legal/procurement lead).
2) PriTech: send any mandatory security or compliance docs you want evaluated ASAP (SOC2 scope, IP/data residency constraints).
3) Redwood (Marcus/Neha/Tessa): we'll update the MAP draft with dates, owners and the evaluation checklist.

I blocked a few 45-min slots here — feel free to pick one: https://calendly.com/redwood/timeslot-pritech-kickoff

Attachments: PriTech_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (xlsx) — proposed milestones and owners; PriTech_Eval_Checklist.docx (docx)

Looking forward —

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0182
https://www.redwood.com

Thanks Tessa — good summary.

Elena and I are aligned to be the exec sponsors. Two quick items from our side:
- Please add our Security contact and SSO requirements to the checklist. We require SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning for pilots that touch user data.
- Would like to see a short section in the MAP on fallback behavior and SLA implications if latency targets are missed during the pilot.

I uploaded a short security packet to our shared drive; I'll have procurement loop in (procurement@pritech.com) for the commercial timeline.

Happy to take the kickoff on Wednesday or Thursday afternoon PT. Javier

Great — thanks Javier. Adding a couple notes from commercial and procurement so timelines are realistic:

Proposed close timeline (aligned to MAP milestones):
- Week 0 (kickoff): finalize MAP owners, security scope and SSO requirements
- Weeks 1–2: technical eval (model perf, latency, KV cache behavior) + security review
- Weeks 3–4: pilot run and blocked-traffic soak; begin procurement review
- Week 5: contract negotiation and DocuSign routing
- Week 6–8: rollout to pilot scope and exec review for Q3 goals

Procurement ask: please confirm the contract approver and any PO process we should know about. For DocuSign routing I’ve created a starter envelope: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/rooms/abc123456

Escalation path (if timelines slip or scope grows):
- Day-to-day: Marcus Lin (sales lead) / Neha Kapoor (solutions)
- Technical escalations: Javier Morales (PriTech CTO) / Tessa Morgan (Redwood AE)
- Exec escalation: Hannah Schmitt (Redwood Head CS) and PriTech exec sponsor (Elena Ruiz)

I’ll incorporate Javier’s SSO note into the checklist and attach an updated MAP PDF to this thread.

Attachments: PriTech_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf)

Regards,

Thanks all — calendar updated for Wed 21 at 11:00 PT per the Calendly pick. I attached the MAP with owners and dates filled in (PriTech_MAP_v1.pdf).

Quick checklist summary for the kickoff meeting:
- Primary objective: validate p50 latency < 80ms and end-to-end demo of 1 production flow by end of pilot.
- Security: PriTech to share SOC2 scope and SAML/SCIM requirements pre-meeting. Redwood to provide anonymized data handling guide.
- Procurement: PriTech to confirm contract approver; Redwood to circulate initial commercial term sheet after kickoff.

If anything changes before Wednesday ping me directly — Neha (mobile +1 415-555-0233).

Thanks,
